title: QBR prep + daily account checklist (Morning)
content:
Morning scratchpad: quick run-through before 9:30 standups. Keep this fuzzy — notes to self, short action items, and things to pull into the QBR slides later.

TODAY BLOCKS
- 08:30–09:00 — Triage: urgent support queue (tickets flagged by priority)
- 09:15 — 1:1 with Marco (renewal strategy for AcmeFinance)
- 10:00 — QBR with NovaHealth (30m) — prep talking points below
- 14:00 — Internal sync: rollout plan for telemetry changes for TalosGames
- 16:00 — Customer follow-ups / email wave

PRIORITY ACCOUNTS (score = risk / impact)
1) AcmeFinance — RISK: HIGH | ARR at stake: $120k | renewal due 2026-06-15
   - Current issues: intermittent latency spikes (>500ms p95) reported by payments team (SUP-789).
   - Open items: engineering patch ETA, temporary routing to eu-1, legal review for addendum.
   - Today: call with Marco at 09:15 to finalize concession options (1-month credit vs extended support).
   - Action checklist: 
     [ ] Confirm patch milestone and rollback plan (Diego).
     [ ] Draft renewal concession language for legal review (me).
     [ ] Prepare SLA delta slide for QBR (Samira).

2) NovaHealth — RISK: MEDIUM | ARR: $70k | QBR 10:00
   - Health metrics: integration success 98%, uptime 99.92%, recent request for per-route tracing.
   - QBR goals: show telemetry improvements, propose Redwood Optimize pilot (3-week) to reduce doc-completion cost 18–22%.
   - Talking points for 10:00 call:
     * Quick wins shipped since last QBR: prefix cache enabled, 12% avg token cost reduction.
     * Proposed pilot: targeted Optimize config + weekly evals, ask for technical contact + 2 prompt sets.
     * Ask: are there compliance docs we should add to Private deployment checklist?
   - Action checklist after call:
     [ ] Capture technical contacts + schedule kickoff (me).
     [ ] Create pilot scope doc and send to product (link to confluence above).

3) TalosGames — RISK: LOW but expansion opportunity | ARR: $35k | ask: A/B rollout of smaller model for chat cost savings
   - Reminder: Talos prefers hands-on rollout support — schedule SRE shadow session W21.
   - Action: propose canary config + rollback runbook, attach example runbook snippet from templates.

SUPPORT FOLLOW-UPS / ESCALATIONS
- SUP-789 (AcmeFinance latency) — escalation email draft needed by 11:00. Points: timeline, temporary workaround, expected remediation window.
- CS-4123 (billing discrepancy - NovaHealth) — finance confirmed it was double-metering; refund applied but customer needs confirmation email.
- New ticket to open: request for per-route tracing for NovaHealth — need to work with infra to scope (tag: observability).

QBR SLIDE DRAFT NOTES (short bullets to paste into deck)
- Slide: "What we shipped" — prefix cache, streaming improvements, cost drop metric + chart (pull from dashboard).
- Slide: "Near-term roadmap" — Optimize pilot, canary rollout for Talos, latency patch schedule for AcmeFinance.
- Slide: "Risks & asks" — specify support window, need technical SMEs, signoff on trial terms.

RENEWAL / NEGOTIATION PLAYBOOK (quick)
- If customer cites cost: propose Optimize pilot first (show projected savings), offer time-limited credits only if pilot unsuccessful.
- If customer cites reliability: offer canary to new region + 24/7 on-call during testing window.
- Always: lock in technical SLA and escalation path in writing before concessions.

NOTES TO SELF / THINGS I KEEP FORGOTTEN
- Bring up telemetry retention tier pricing (some customers assume default is unlimited).
- Ask legal for precedent on 30-day service credits — last time we used clause X (Confluence page id above).
- Remember to cc AM on refund confirmation for NovaHealth.

POST-QBR FOLLOW-UPS (templates)
- Quick email template lines: "Thanks for your time — next steps: 1) kickoff pilot 2) confirm tech leads 3) align on timeline. I'll follow up with calendar invites and the scope doc."
- Checklist to close within 48h: 
  [ ] Send pilot scope
  [ ] Book kickoff
  [ ] Share telemetry access instructions

QUICK LINKS I NEED TODAY
- Confluence QBR template: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=123456
- Support ticket (Acme latency): JIRA-SUP-789
- Billing ticket: JIRA-CS-4123
- Internal PR for telemetry work: https://github.com/redwood-inference/portal/pull/842
- Slack channel to ping (engineering-observability): https://slack-redwood.slack.com/archives/C02CUST123

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS PENDING
- Legal: can we include a month of credits without escalating to finance? (ask: Lila)
- Infra: ETA for latency patch vs recommended mitigation (Diego to confirm by 11:30).
- Product: can Optimize pilot be run in private deployment mode for NovaHealth? (ask: Samira)

END NOTES
- Keep this doc minimal — transfer final items into QBR deck and tickets.
- If I don’t finish escalation draft by 11:00, notify Marco and ask him to lead the call.

Snapshot at 08:10 — starting triage now.

-- Riley
